changelog:
- Initial release of the Google Ads Transparency API skill via Scavio.
- Resolve a brand or domain to a verified Google advertiser id.
- Pull all ads run by an advertiser across Search, YouTube, Shopping, Maps, and Play.
- Retrieve detailed creative information with full region and impression history.
- Supports three endpoints: advertisers resolution, ad search with filters, and creative lookup.
- Includes comprehensive setup instructions and usage guidelines for competitor ad research and ad-intelligence workflows.
display_name: Google Ads Transparency API - Advertiser Lookup, Live Ad Creatives
summary: Resolve a brand or domain to a Google advertiser id, then pull every ad it runs across Search, YouTube, Shopping, Maps and Play, and open one creative with its full region and impression history. 3 endpoints, 1 credit each.
